conflicts.problem: Coulomb's Law is taught twice, in Lesson 3 and again in Lesson 5, with the same title. Lesson 8 then refers to 'Q-V graph knowledge (Lesson 5 and 6)' although the Q-V graph is introduced in Lesson 7. The lesson numbering and sequence are inconsistent.

Lesson 7 states that the cloud-to-ground gap stored up to 1.5 × 10⁹ J. Lesson 6 says the energy would be calculated in Lesson 8. Lesson 8 covers E = ½CV² but gives no matching figure. This unsupported energy value is not used consistently.

Lesson 3 says the cloud was 800 m above the Rift Valley Escarpment with 20 C. This conflicts with the Ol Kalou, Nyandarua setting. Lesson 5 says the roof was struck because it was the closest large conductor, yet the wooden stall is adjacent. Lesson 1 says charge from friction builds up the cloud, while Lesson 4 treats the roof as charged by induction.
